bounded_model.state: q_new=sigmoid(logit(clip(q,1e-6,1-1e-6))*((1-u)*s_cold+u*s_hot)), eachanchorin[-1,1]. Two parameters; canreverse orshrink butnotamplify rawlogodds. No extra intercept.
bounded_model.additive_control: q_new=sigmoid(s*logit(clip(q))+b*(2u-1)),s,b in[-1,1]. Same2parametercapacity, separates additive state direction from conditional q reliability.
bounded_model.primary_penalty: .25*((s_cold-1)^2+(s_hot-1)^2)=.5*(mean_slope-1)^2+.5*(half_difference)^2; equal anchors reduces exactly to v51 scalar objective.
bounded_model.objective: Weighted binarylogloss(I(D>0)); weights=timeweight*abs(D),normalizeNdates. Strictly convex because all parameter penalties positive. Zero magnitude mass preserves q exactly.
bounded_model.solver: Primary/additive exact2D box Newton quadratic step enumerates all9faces; Armijo line search50max; max100steps; solve tolerance1e-10*Ndates and finalprojectedgradient<=1e-8*Ndates. Global control delegates exactfrozenv51 scalar bisection.
